reports.title: Ridgeland, MS – Barnett Reservoir Host CrappieNOW Media Camp, by Richard Simms, CrappieNOW Editor
reports.text:
Distant shorelines were just barely visible and it felt like we were dead center of the 33,000-acre lake when Chappell backed his boat down and fired up his electronics. As he headed from the 30-foot main channel up onto a 14-foot ledge toward one of his 3,000 waypoints, a large brushpile came into view on his Garmin Livescope. The brushpile lit up like a Christmas tree and Chappell said, “There’s 150 or 200 crappie in that tree.”
Some of those ledges received some additional structure as the CrappieNOW crew added two John Godwin Signature Mossback Fish Habitat structures.
For visitors the Madison Landing Boat Launch is just minutes away from excellent hotels and is an impressive launch…

reports.title: The Outlaw Max Game Changer – an innovation in crappie fishing
reports.text:
The 333 Restaurant in Grenada, Mississippi will certainly go down in history as a great place to eat. It will also be recognized as the birthplace of the Outlaw Max Game Changer. In 2012 during a Bass Pro Shops Crappie Masters tournament, pro crappie angler Whitey Outlaw shared an idea for a new jig. Using a 333 Restaurant napkin he drew out his revolutionary concept for Rockport Rattler owner Charles Sablatura.
The idea he sketched out that day was a jig head with three hooks. “My lure has three hooks and you can bend them anyway you want. Straight up and down, side by side, many combinations are possible.” Of course the new jig head also contains the all ready proven rattle system of the…
